name: io.github.WYRE-AI/avanan-legacy-mcp
title: Avanan MSP (Legacy SmartAPI)
description: MCP server for the legacy Avanan SmartAPI: MSP tenant management plus per-tenant security tools.

environmentVariables.name: AVANAN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: MSP API Client ID issued by Avanan Support (sent as x-av-app-id)

environmentVariables.name: AVANAN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: MSP API Client Secret used to sign every request (x-av-sig); never sent on the wire

environmentVariables.name: AVANAN_REGION
environmentVariables.description: API region: us (default), eu, ca, ap, euw2 (UK), or aps1 (India). Avanan issues one key per region.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' for local CLI use, 'http' for gateway hosting

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
